Convergence of the Surplus Production MPs

Source: R/performance_metrics.R
Calc_SP_Convergence.Rd

The proportion of management cycles in which the surplus production model of each MP converged, from MSEtool::SPEstimates(). When the fit fails or does not converge, the advice is set by the OnFail rule of MSEtool::SurplusProduction() (by default, the previous TAC is kept).

Usage

Calc_SP_Convergence(MSE)

Arguments

MSE

An mse object.

Value

A data.frame with columns MP, nCycles (management cycles over all simulations), and Converged (proportion of cycles); no rows if no MP fits a surplus production model.
